# PolarChart

**Class:** `UltraCanvasPolarChart` · **Group:** [Charts](../Groups/Charts.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Charts/UltraCanvasPolarChart.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Charts/UltraCanvasPolarChart.h) · `#include "Plugins/Charts/UltraCanvasPolarChart.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasChartElementBase`](UltraCanvasChartElementBase.md) → [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

Angle / radius space: polar series, radial bars, activity rings, ringed infographic

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasPolarChart> CreatePolarChart( const std::string& id, int x, int y, int w, int h);
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasPolarChart> CreatePolarScatterChart( const std::string& id, int x, int y, int w, int h, const std::vector<std::pair<std::string, std::vector<std::pair<double, double>>>>& seriesData);   // Numeric polar scatter: each entry is one named series of (angle, radius).
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasPolarChart> CreatePolarRoseChart( const std::string& id, int x, int y, int w, int h, const std::vector<std::string>& categories, const std::vector<std::pair<std::string, std::vector<double>>>& seriesData, PolarStackMode stackMode = PolarStackMode::Stacked);   // Categorical rose / stacked polar column chart.
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasPolarChart(const std::string& id, int x, int y, int w, int h);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Option types in this header

### struct `PolarDataPoint`

A single observation in polar space. In Numeric angle mode `angle` is a value on the angular axis (degrees by default); in Categorical mode the point's position comes from its index in the series and `angle` is unused.

| Field | Declaration | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `angle` | `double angle = 0.0` |  |
| `radius` | `double radius = 0.0` |  |
| `label` | `std::string label` |  |
| `color` | `Color color = Colors::Transparent` | Transparent = inherit series color |
| `markerSize` | `float markerSize = 0.0f` | 0 = inherit series marker size |

### enum `PolarSeriesType`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Line` | Straight segments between consecutive points |
| `Spline` | Catmull-Rom smoothed curve |
| `Area` | Line plus a fill down to the base radius |
| `SplineArea` | Spline plus a fill down to the base radius |
| `Scatter` | Markers only |
| `Column` | Annular sectors (polar columns / Nightingale rose) |

### enum `PolarCategoryPlacement`

Where categories sit relative to the angular grid lines.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `OnSpokes` | Category angle lies on a grid spoke (radar look) |
| `BetweenSpokes` | Grid spokes fall on slot boundaries (column look) |

### struct `PolarAngleAxisStyle`

Styling for one ring of angular labels. The chart draws a primary ring and an optional secondary ring (different interval / placement / colour), which is how dual angle-axis layouts are produced.

| `visible` | `bool visible = true` |  |

| `labelOffset` | `float labelOffset = 12.0f` | pixels from the axis circle |
